gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology; no GRE Subject Test exists for Medical Sciences.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Graduate School Admission Guideline for International Students only requires pre-application advisor selection in the application/study plan for Psychology, Cognitive Science, and Integrated Design, and does not state a pre-application supervisor requirement for this department.

funding.value: Students in the College of Medicine are ineligible for the Yonsei International Companion Scholarship, but are eligible for competitive Graduate Student Assistantships (within the tuition fee range), Yonsei Graduate Fellowships (research incentives up to KRW 7.5 million), BK21 Four Medical Sciences scholarships, and GKS full-tuition plus living-stipend scholarships.

entry_route.value: Yonsei University Graduate School offers both the Integrated Master's-Ph.D. Program (open to applicants holding a Bachelor's degree) and the Ph.D. Program (open to applicants holding a Master's degree) in this department.
entry_route.quote: 1. Eligibility for All Applicants | Master / Integrated Ph. D | w Someone who (will) be awarded a Bachelor’s Degree w Someone who (will) be awarded a Master’s Degree | Medicine ○ ○ ○ Neurosurgery, Orthopedic Surgery, Biomedical Science

notes: Medical Sciences (BK21 Project) comprises five tracks (Molecular, Cellular & Cancer Biology; Infectious Diseases & Immunobiology; Genomics & Data Sciences; Brain & Cognitive Sciences; Regenerative Biology & Translational Medicine) and requires TOEFL iBT 4.0 (72) or IELTS 6.0.
